headline: Mexico survive a scare, Canada march on
summary: The hosts trembled until Lozano's 88th-minute penalty. Canada brushed Qatar aside 4-0 and pile on the goal-difference pressure.

matches.pill: Giménez headed Mexico in from inside the box, set up by Lozano, but South Africa drew level through an unfortunate own goal. Lozano settled it from the spot in the 88th. Mokoena's sending-off broke the visitors' momentum.
Canada were never troubled and pocketed three quiet points. Qatar already have it tough in Group B. Goal difference may yet matter at the end.

tonight.why: Brazil's opener against a Morocco side that reached the semis last time - this one promises heat.
A small match at 1am - sleep wins this one.
